criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Identifies frozen-in-time rules reference (2022 Edition locked in)
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 11 identifies the lock to Rules in effect at signing (March 15, 2023), i.e. the 2022 Edition, despite the 2024 Edition.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_001: Discusses practical implications of frozen rules reference
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses SAI applying current provisions under Preamble/Art. 35.3, uncertainty on fees, EA mechanics, and Art. 34(2)(a)(iv) risk.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Identifies sole arbitrator vs. three-member tribunal default under Article 6
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 9 identifies sole arbitrator vs Art. 6.3 CHF 5m three-member default.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes that total amount in controversy exceeds the Article 6 threshold
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 9 notes $13.3m (~CHF 11.9m) and that Greenleaf's claim alone exceeds CHF 5m.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_002: Notes party agreement on sole arbitrator is permissible but flags risks
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes Art. 6.2 gives effect to agreement and flags Art. 6.5 override risk and Kuiper request plus set-aside risk.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Identifies 15-day vs. 30-day appointment deadline conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 identifies 15-day clause window vs Art. 6.4 30 days.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: Analyzes which deadline controls and gap between day 15 and day 30
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes that the clause prevails under Art. 1.4 and whether SAI Court power arises on day 16 or day 30.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_003: References Kuiper's counsel email position on the 30-day period
criteria_results.reasoning: Addresses Kuiper's October 28 position that it will rely on 30 days and object before day 30.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies dual language ambiguity (no primary/controlling language specified)
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes both languages co-equal, clause fixes only submissions and is silent on hearings, award and translation, i.e. no controlling language.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Identifies gap regarding language of the award
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies clause silence on award language and Art. 12.2(c) tribunal determination.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: Discusses practical risks of language ambiguity
criteria_results.reasoning: Discusses translation costs, delays, narrowed arbitrator pool and enforcement translation needs under NYC Art. IV(2).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_004: References Kuiper's counsel position on German language
criteria_results.reasoning: Addresses Kuiper's expectation of German submissions and German award, and the 'negotiated in German' claim.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies 90-day vs. 180-day award deadline conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 identifies 90 days from constitution vs Art. 24 180-day best-efforts target from last hearing/submission.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Identifies differing trigger events for award deadline
criteria_results.reasoning: Explicitly identifies differing trigger (constitution vs close of proceedings).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_005: Assesses impracticality of 90-day deadline for this dispute
criteria_results.reasoning: Assesses 90 days as not realistically achievable; flags arbitrators declining, set-aside and due-process risks.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies conflict between clause's consequential damages exclusion and Article 34
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies that clause excludes consequential damages while Art. 34.1(a) expressly allows them.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Notes clause is consistent with Rules on punitive/exemplary damages but goes further
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes punitive/exemplary limb consistent with Art. 34.2 while consequential exclusion narrows Art. 34.1(a).

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_006: Identifies that exclusion undermines Greenleaf's $3.2M claim
criteria_results.reasoning: Connects exclusion to threat to the $3.2m outage claim.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies perpetual vs. five-year confidentiality conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies perpetual vs Art. 20.3 five years after final award.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: Identifies missing carve-outs in clause's confidentiality provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies absence of Art. 20.2 exceptions and resulting inability to disclose for law, enforcement, regulators.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_007: References Kuiper's counsel position on perpetual confidentiality
criteria_results.reasoning: Addresses Kuiper's assertion that all information relating to the dispute is confidential, as overbroad.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_008: Identifies cost allocation clause vs. Article 26.3 override
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies Art. 26.3 manifestly unreasonable safety valve and tribunal's residual discretion.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Identifies enforceability risk of blanket appeal waiver
criteria_results.reasoning: States set-aside grounds under Model Law Art. 34/IAA s. 24 cannot be excluded and a waiver read to cover set-aside would be ineffective.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_009: Correctly identifies non-waivable grounds under Singapore law
criteria_results.reasoning: Names non-waivable grounds including fraud, corruption, breach of natural justice, excess of mandate.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Identifies discovery restriction vs. tribunal's broad discretion
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies tension between document-production-only limit and Arts. 14.3, 17, 18.2 broad evidentiary powers.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_010: Analyzes scope of 'discovery' vs. 'evidence-taking'
criteria_results.reasoning: Analyzes that 'discovery' refers to compelled disclosure, not presentation of witness statements and expert evidence.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Confirms emergency arbitrator procedure remains available
criteria_results.reasoning: Confirms EA procedure available as clause silent with no express opt-out.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Connects emergency arbitrator availability to Greenleaf's needs
criteria_results.reasoning: Connects EA availability to server-log preservation before deletion.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_011: Notes Article 15.4 preserves right to seek judicial interim relief
criteria_results.reasoning: Notes Art. 15.4 and interplay with EA and s. 14.3(d) court carve-out.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Identifies governing law vs. seat of arbitration distinction
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 13 explains NY law governs substance, Singapore law governs procedure and set-aside.

criteria_results.title: ISSUE_012: Flags potential complications from governing law / seat split
criteria_results.reasoning: Flags complications, e.g. damages exclusion under NY law vs excess-of-mandate review at seat, law of arbitration agreement gap.

criteria_results.title: Each issue includes a severity rating
criteria_results.reasoning: Every issue carries a Critical/High/Moderate/Low rating.

criteria_results.title: Recommendation for sole arbitrator conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 9 recommendations: maintain sole arbitrator, oppose Art. 6.5 request, confirm FX rate.

criteria_results.title: Recommendation for appointment deadline conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 5 recommendations: written rejection, shortlist, Secretariat confirmation, SAI Court request.

criteria_results.title: Recommendation for award deadline conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 1 recommendations: written modification, Terms of Reference, Singapore counsel.

criteria_results.title: Recommendation for consequential damages exclusion
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 2 recommendations: review ss. 7.4/13, re-model claim, plead carve-outs and public policy.

criteria_results.title: Recommendation for confidentiality conflict
criteria_results.reasoning: Issue 7 recommendations: reject Kuiper reading, confidentiality protocol, NDAs.

criteria_results.title: Report assesses strategic implications from Greenleaf's perspective
criteria_results.reasoning: Extensive strategic assessment from Greenleaf's claimant perspective (e.g. burden of proof, cost recovery loss).

criteria_results.title: Correctly states total amount in controversy as $13.3 million
criteria_results.reasoning: States $11.9m claim plus counterclaim = $13.3m.

criteria_results.title: Correctly identifies Article 6 threshold as CHF 5 million (~$5.6M)
criteria_results.reasoning: States CHF 5 million threshold, ~$5.6 million.

criteria_results.title: Correctly identifies the applicable rules edition as 2022 (not 2024)
criteria_results.reasoning: Identifies 2022 Edition (effective Jan 1, 2022) as applicable and 2024 Edition (July 1, 2024) as current but not applicable.

criteria_results.title: Report addresses enforceability analysis for at least one provision
criteria_results.reasoning: Enforceability analysis under Singapore law for award deadline, damages exclusion, appeal waiver.
